name: hunter
label: Hunter
description: Find, verify and manage professional email addresses at scale. Automate email discovery, validation, lead tracking, and campaign outreach with Hunter.io.

token.label: API Key
token.description: Copy your API key from the [Hunter API page](https://hunter.io/api-keys) (Dashboard > API).

count-emails.label: Count Emails
count-emails.description: Returns the number of email addresses found for a domain or company.

domain.label: Domain
domain.description: Company domain, e.g. "stripe.com". At least one of domain or company is required; domain wins when both are set.

company.label: Company
company.description: Company name, e.g. "Stripe". Used only when no domain is given.

type.label: Type
type.description: Only "personal" or "generic" email addresses. Leave empty for both.

verify-email.label: Verify Email
verify-email.description: Check email deliverability. Uses 0.5 credit per new email verified.

name.label: Name
name.description: Name of the new leads list.

get_account.label: Get Account
get_account.description: Get your Hunter plan, credits used and available, and the reset date.
